title: Kitchen Line Shuffle
style: Upbeat pop-rap with a bouncy mid-tempo groove and tight syncopated percussion; verse rides lean drum-pocket rhythms with quick callout phrasing, pre-chorus strips to clap snaps and a rising synth pulse, chorus hits with stacked gang vocals and a punchy stomp pattern. Vocal is close-mic, confident, with doubled hook lines, ad-lib shouts, and delay throws on key words. Ear candy includes sneaker squeaks, short risers, and a bright whistle stab into the drop. Mix is crisp, athletic, and front-facing.
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Lace up, check grip
Step in, locked in
Eyes on the third shot
Ready for the win

Quick feet, quick hands
Split step, then slide
Corner to the center
I’m never out of time

Pulse up, calm face
I read the bounce clean
Pick up every angle
Like I was made for this scene

[Pre-Chorus]
Low stance
Fast turn
Don’t freeze
Just learn

Breathe in
Move light
Game face
All fight

[Chorus]
Pickle ball pro
Feet on fire
Pickle ball pro
Move up higher
Step, split, go
Win that point
Pickle ball pro
Right on joint

[Verse 2]
Pop serve, return tight
Backhand by the line
Little hop, reset
I’m ahead of the climb

No wasted motion
No drag in the pace
Every tiny shuffle
Puts me right in place

Pressure on
I like that
Say my name
I fight back

[Pre-Chorus]
Low stance
Fast turn
Don’t freeze
Just learn

Breathe in
Move light
Game face
All fight

[Chorus]
Pickle ball pro
Feet on fire
Pickle ball pro
Move up higher
Step, split, go
Win that point
Pickle ball pro
Right on joint

[Bridge]
One more rally
One more run
See that opening
I’m already gone

Left, right, snap
I own that lane
Every pre-game
Feeds the flame

[Final Chorus]
Pickle ball pro
Feet on fire
Pickle ball pro
Move up higher
Step, split, go
Win that point
Pickle ball pro
Right on joint

Pickle ball pro
Hear it roar
Pickle ball pro
Want it more
Step, split, go
Take that court
Pickle ball pro
I’m in form
